# ECLMS 2.0 ESG Module — Single Authoritative Agent Mandate

## 1. Scope & Design Authority
- Domain: Enterprise Collateral Lifecycle Management System (ECLMS 2.0).
- Standards: BTC Application Metadata & UX Configuration Design Standard.
- UX Rules: Enterprise Blue palette (#0f2d59 / #1a56a6 / #f0f4f9), left sidebar for high-level collateral categories only, horizontal tabs on the assessment canvas, zero authentication barrier on initial landing.

## 2. Navigation & View Routing Architecture
- Universal Search Landing: every rail entry routes to `#view-search` with a scope (`currentCategoryScope` = ALL / PROPERTY / MANUFACTURING / VEHICLE) that filters the register and sets the header title (Global Collateral Master Register / Property / Manufacturing Plant / Vehicle Fleet Collateral Portfolio). No "last active collateral" memory; forms never open from the rail.
- Forms open ONLY from a grid row's Add/Edit: `FRM_PROP` -> dual-mode `#view-assessment-form`; `CORE_MFG` -> `#view-mfg-form`; vehicle rows toast "The template is under development." Administration is a sidebar parent whose child "CVM Maintenance" opens the Code Value Master view (`#view-admin-cvm`, `js/admin/cvm-service.js`). The CVM API is live and two-tier, served by the Express app in `eclms-esg-api/` (`cvm-routes.js`, `server.js`) against PostgreSQL via `DATABASE_URL`. Run it with `npm start` from `eclms-esg-api/` and open `http://localhost:3000/index.html`; `file://` cannot reach the API. `GET /api/admin/cvm/categories` (backed by `btc_cvm_mst_index`) is cached once at page load and fills the Master Category dropdown; `GET /api/admin/cvm/values?mstrCode=&status=&search=&page=&pageSize=` (backed by `btc_cvm_val`) returns `{items,total,page,pageSize}` and is queried on every filter change (absent `status` means ACTIVE, empty means all). `POST /api/admin/cvm` creates a value under an existing ACTIVE category (the category name is copied from `btc_cvm_mst_index`); `PUT /api/admin/cvm/{recId}` updates a value, and its category key and name stay fixed. Categories are managed through `GET /api/admin/cvm/master-categories` (ordered by `mstr_name`), `POST /api/admin/cvm/master-categories` (sets `created_at` and `updated_at`, returns 409 on a duplicate key), and `PUT /api/admin/cvm/master-categories/{mstrCode}` (`mstr_code` is immutable; a rename propagates `mstr_name` to `btc_cvm_val`). The `[+ New Category]` and `[Edit Category]` buttons open a second drawer built from `GET /api/meta/forms/FRM_CVM_MST_INDEX`. It renders only ACTIVE columns, so `CREATED_AT` and `UPDATED_AT` are skipped. `PARENT_MSTR_CODE` is disabled and cleared when `HAS_PARENT` is `N`, and its options come from `/master-categories` when the drawer opens. Cycles in the parent chain are rejected. The Create/Edit drawer is built at runtime from `GET /api/meta/forms/FRM_CVM_MAINT` (`meta-routes.js`, joining `esg_form_meta`, `esg_form_colmn_meta` and the `esg_tbl_col_frm_col_map` bridge). `renderMetadataForm()` in `cvm-service.js` lays fields out on a 12-column grid, skips non-insertable fields on create, locks non-updatable fields on edit, and wires the `fld_has_parent` -> `fld_parent_mstr` dependency. Label and placeholder keys map to text in the client. There is no mock data in the client. Selects with more than 5 options are upgraded to searchable TomSelect controls (vendored in `vendor/tom-select/`). Field borders use the global `.input-mandatory` (red), `.input-conditional` (amber, with a "Conditional: depends on ..." hint) and `.input-valid` (green) classes, applied to the visible `.ts-control` for searchable selects. The drawer form uses `novalidate`, so required checks run in JS (`cvmFindMissingRequired`). The UX rules for borders, searchable dropdowns and the no-hardcoded-lists policy are in [ARCHITECTURE_UX_STANDARDS.md](../docs/architecture/ARCHITECTURE_UX_STANDARDS.md).
- ESG Scoring Rubric Maintenance is a sibling child of Administration, labelled "ESG Scoring Model" (`#view-admin-rubric`, `js/admin/rubric-service.js`). Its header is "ESG Scoring Model Maintenance" with a `[Manage Section Weights]` button and a `← Back` button. The "[+ Add Scoring Rule]" button and drawer were removed. It shares the `.admin-screen` CSS scope with the CVM screen. The API is `eclms-esg-api/routes/rubric-routes.js`, mounted at `/api/admin/rubric` on `esg_attr_score_rubric`. `GET` is paged (`{items,total,page,pageSize}`) and filters on `coll_type`, `model_version`, `source_table`, `attr_code`, `match_operator`, and `status` (empty means all). `POST` defaults `rubric_id` to `gen_random_uuid()`, `PUT /{rubricId}` is a partial merge, and `DELETE /{rubricId}` soft-deletes by setting `status = 'INACTIVE'`. Collateral type is persisted to `coll_type` and validated against active `COLL_TYPE` values in `btc_cvm_val`. Options come from `GET /api/cvm/values?category=COLL_TYPE` (`cvm-lookup-routes.js`). `base_score` is edited per row. Read-only scores show as `XX.00`. The Edit icon turns the row into a 32px numeric input with spinners hidden, and Save (check) or Cancel (X) follows. Save sends `PUT /api/admin/rubric/:rubricId` with `{ base_score }`. Actions are icon buttons: Edit, then Deactivate or Activate, which send `{ status }` through the same PUT. The header's `[Manage Section Weights]` opens the ESG Section Weights screen (`ADMIN_SECTION_WEIGHTS`, `js/admin/section-weight-service.js`). Its API is `routes/section-weight-routes.js`, mounted at `/api/admin/section-weights`. `GET` defaults `coll_type` to `PROP` (also accepts `collType`) and is paged. `PUT` takes `{coll_type, model_version, sections:[{section_code, weight_pct}]}` and saves weights only when ACTIVE rows for the collateral type total exactly 100.00, enforced server-side in integer cents. The screen is read-only by default. `[Edit]` enables whole-number entry, and `[Cancel]` discards edits. Save is enabled only while editing with a 100.00 total. Universal control height is 38px for `.ts-control`, `.form-select` and `.form-control`. Grid rows use `.grid-number-input` at 32px.
- ESG Grade & Haircuts is a sibling child of Administration, below ESG Section Weights (`#view-admin-grade-haircuts`, `js/admin/grade-haircut-service.js`, nav key `ADMIN_GRADE_HAIRCUTS`). It is opened from `[Manage Grade Matrix]` on the ESG Scoring Model toolbar. Min/Max/Haircut are read-only until `[Edit]`, bands must be contiguous 0.00–100.00, and the API is `/api/admin/grade-haircuts` (`routes/grade-haircut-routes.js`, GET and PUT only).

- Server-side grid paging is the standard: every record grid sends `page` and `pageSize` (`APP_CONFIG.GridNoOfRows`, 50) and renders only the returned page from `{items, total, page, pageSize}`. `serverPage()` implements that contract for the in-browser stand-ins; `renderGridPager()` draws the footer, and filter changes reset to page 1.
- Vehicle form (`#view-veh-form`): 6 complete tabs for template `FRM_VEH` (1: Identification `VID` with VAHAN integration, 2: Usage & Energy `VUS`, 3: Compliance & Fleet Health `VCP`, 4: Climate & Transition Risk `VTR`, 5: Battery & Circularity `VST`, 6: Scoring & Valuation `VOUT` with 78.10/100 outcome, section breakdown, valuation adjustment to ₹24L base -> ₹22.80L adjusted). Includes persistent vehicle summary strip on Tabs 2-5, KPI micro-cards, and full `FORM_CONTEXTS.veh` dual-mode sign-off.
- Manufacturing form (`#view-mfg-form`): Sections 1 (MFGLOC), 2 (MFGENV) and 3 (MFGWAT) built; tabs 4-5 placeholders. Same dual-mode rules as Property via shared `FORM_CONTEXTS` (prop/mfg) machinery: NEW mode = sequential sign-off gate with freeze + Re-open cascade; EDIT mode = free tabs with dirty-lock. Section 1 validates PCB category/zone/shifts + facility coordinate regex. Drafts persist under `ESG_DRAFT_<COLLATERAL_ID>` for both forms.
- Tab logic is scoped per form view (`#view-assessment-form` / `#view-mfg-form`); never query `.form-tab-btn`/`.tab-panel` globally.
- Focus rings keep the 4-tier border color (required red / conditional amber / optional green / derived grey) with `!important`; the blue accent focus never overrides them.
- Property Assessment routes to `FRM_PROP` for the last-viewed or first property collateral.
- Selecting a category locks search results to that asset class.
- Selecting a collateral item opens the multi-tab assessment canvas for that asset type.

## 3. Data Entry & Behavioral Guards
- Geospatial coordinates (Latitude/Longitude) must use standard text inputs with regex validation; never use `<input type="number">`.
- Tab navigation enforces dirty-state tracking (`mark-dirty`); unsaved edits must display a prompt (Save, Discard, Cancel) before tab switching.

## 4. Current Milestone Delivery: Section 1 (PRPLOC)
Maintain all 16 elements from Annexure-2 Section 4:
- System Lineage: `ASSESSMENT_ID`, `COLLATERAL_ID`, `ASSESSMENT_VERSION`, `ASSESSMENT_TYPE`, `ASSESSMENT_DATE`, `ASSESSMENT_STATUS`, `DATA_FRESHNESS_STATUS`, `NEXT_REVIEW_DATE`.
- Physical Attributes: `PROP_TYPE_USAGE`, `OPERATING_STATUS`, `PROPERTY_AGE_YRS`, `LATITUDE`, `LONGITUDE`, `CITY_DISTRICT`, `IS_COASTAL_ZONE`, `BUILTUP_AREA_SQFT`.
- Section 1 is frozen once formally verified (signed off); Section 2 (Environmental Baseline) and later sections stay locked until then.

## 5. Field Indicators & Drafts (latest directives)
- Use `var(--danger, #dc2626)`; never `var(--danger-color)`.
- Required: `border-left: 3px solid var(--danger)` plus `<span class="req-star">*</span>`. Derived/System: read-only, `#f8fafc` background, `border-left: 3px solid #94a3b8`. Optional: standard border. No textual badges (e.g. `D - PCT-001`) in labels.
- Sign-off requires ASSESSMENT_TYPE, PROP_TYPE_USAGE, OPERATING_STATUS, valid coordinates and BUILTUP_AREA_SQFT > 0. Re-open Section 1 requires confirmation; never revoke sign-off silently.
- `beforeunload` while `isFormDirty` silently saves the draft to `sessionStorage` under `ESG_DRAFT_<COLLATERAL_ID>` and triggers the native warning.

## 6. Sections 2-6 (Section 1 confirmed signed off by the user)
- Tabs: 2 Environmental Baseline (PRPENV), 3 Physical Climate Risk (PRPCLI), 4 Resilience & Insurance (PRPRES), 5 Compliance & Social, 6 ESG Assessment Summary, then the Observation Ledger. All stay locked until Section 1 is signed off.
- Section 6 (`prop-tab-sec-6`, ESG Assessment Summary) is read-only and not signable. It has no sign-off bar. It is generated from the saved sections (`renderPropSummary`) and shows a pending state in NEW mode until Sections 1-5 are signed off.
- Section 6 scoring: pillar weights are 15/25/20/20/20 (sum 100). Score = sum(weight x raw) / 100. Grade ladder: A >=85 (0% haircut), B+ >=75 (2.5%), B >=65 (5%), C >=50 (10%), D <50 (20%). These thresholds and haircut tiers are provisional and must be confirmed by the policy owner.
- Section 6 pillar raw scores come from the record (`esg_pillars`), and the policy haircut (`policy_haircut_pct`) is provisional.
- Y/N-driven dependent groups use `data-toggles` / `data-show-when` and `applyDependentGroups()`.

## 7. Dual-Mode Workflow (EDIT vs NEW)
- Mode = `has_assessment` (or explicit `mode` passed to `selectCollateral`): true -> EDIT, false -> NEW.
- EDIT: all tabs unlocked in any order; Section 1 status pill hidden. Editing a section (`isFormDirty`) locks the other tabs (`.locked`, toast on click) and shows the sign-off bar. Sign-off (or header Save Draft) validates/saves, clears dirty state, hides the bar and unlocks tabs without freezing inputs.
- NEW: Sections 2-6 and the ledger start `.locked`. Each sign-off freezes that section and unlocks the next; Re-open (with confirm) unfreezes it and clears later sign-offs.
- All six sections (1-6) are defined; Section 5 (CSO) and Section 6 (OUT, derived read-only) follow the supplied definitions.
- `BUILTUP_AREA_SQFT` must be numeric and > 0.
- Locked tabs stay clickable (no `pointer-events:none`) so the lock toast can show.
